summary_en: This Phase 3 study compares avutometinib plus defactinib with a treatment chosen by the investigator in recurrent low-grade serous ovarian cancer that has progressed after platinum-based therapy. Avutometinib is taken by mouth as 3.2 mg twice weekly and defactinib as 200 mg twice daily, each for 21 days on and 7 days off in 28-day cycles; the comparison arm uses pegylated liposomal doxorubicin IV, paclitaxel IV, anastrozole by mouth, or letrozole by mouth on the schedules listed. The record says the study will assess safety and efficacy, but the main outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 3 compara avutometinib más defactinib con un tratamiento elegido por el investigador en cáncer de ovario seroso de bajo grado recurrente que progresó después de una terapia basada en platino. Avutometinib se toma por vía oral en dosis de 3.2 mg dos veces por semana y defactinib en dosis de 200 mg dos veces al día, ambos durante 21 días seguidos de 7 días sin tratamiento, en ciclos de 28 días; el brazo de comparación usa doxorrubicina liposomal pegilada IV, paclitaxel IV, anastrozol oral o letrozol oral según los esquemas indicados. El registro indica que el estudio evaluará la seguridad y la eficacia, pero el resultado principal no se indica.
who_for: Histologically proven low-grade serous cancer of the ovary, fallopian tube, or peritoneum
KRAS mutation status documented by a validated tumor tissue test
Progression or recurrence after at least one prior systemic therapy for metastatic disease
Measurable disease per RECIST v1.1 and ECOG performance status of 1 or less
Age 18 years or older and suitable for at least one investigator's choice treatment
not_for: Co-existing high-grade serous ovarian cancer or mixed histology
Prior avutometinib, defactinib, or other FAK inhibitor treatment
Systemic anti-cancer therapy within 4 weeks before the first study dose
History of interstitial lung disease, pneumonitis, or pulmonary fibrosis
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or known hypersensitivity to study drug ingredients
